title: Lagged U.S. three-month Treasury yield easing for BTC long or cash
thesis: A lower nominal three-month U.S. Treasury yield than sixty-three valid business observations earlier may identify easing short-end funding conditions in which next-week BTC exposure has better risk-adjusted economics than unconditional buy-and-hold.
mechanism: On the final valid U.S. Treasury business date of each ISO week, subtract the three-month yield exactly sixty-three valid observations earlier from the latest three-month yield. Make the state available no earlier than the observation date plus one calendar day at 00:00 UTC and hold BTC from the first eligible H1 open only when the change is strictly negative; otherwise hold zero-yield cash until the next weekly factor update.
